meaning: Subtract these counts from the published ones while a keeping source is selected. No published file changes; without this packet every count is the published one.
rule: A dated run is a copy when all its calls appear, in order and within a minute, in a run from another source on the same date. Of two equal copies the run starting in its own feed country is kept; a partial copy is dropped in favour of the fuller run. An alternative-tier run that is fuller than the primary run it matches is a copy only between that run's calls; its single call times match either time of the primary run, and the primary run may list calls between its ends that the alternative omits.

traffic.reason: The delivery stores each physical section as counts per source and pass class. The supporting connections listed for a section are bounded examples, not the complete contributing legs, and no file links a section to the trains counted on it. A copy therefore cannot be attributed to the sections it is counted on without rebuilding the section product.
